title: If the user manually ended/switched from a limited connection, do not automatically reconnect to it if the current connection is lost
line: After you switch away from a network with limited connectivity, Plasma no longer jumps back to it on its own when the new network drops.
explanation: When you pick another network in the applet, plasma-nm just activates it and NetworkManager replaces the current connection with reason 'new-activation'. NetworkManager only blocks autoconnect of a profile when it is deactivated by the user, so the limited network stayed eligible and was the first thing it rejoined when the new network went away. Now, if the global connectivity is Limited or Portal and the network being left is the primary connection on that device, plasma-nm deactivates it explicitly before activating the new one. NetworkManager then blocks its autoconnect (in memory only, no saved setting changes) until the user connects to it again by hand or NetworkManager restarts.

commits.message:
handler: stop autoconnecting to a limited network the user switched from

Switching networks let the new activation replace the old one, which
NetworkManager doesn't count as a user disconnect, so it rejoined the
limited network when the new one dropped. Deactivate it first instead.

BUG: 525694
